messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Problem after version 0.5-18
parts:
On 04/07/2015 09:52 AM, Ashenafi Kassahun wrote:
> Dear Yves and Lavaan users,
>
> I recently upgraded to Lavaan version .05-18. However, I am having
> strange results with functions related with Lavaan. Eg. I had a
> measurementinvariance test with semTool() which perfectly worked in the
> previous version.

Yes, the new update of lavaan (0.5-18) broke some functions in semTools
(0.4-6). This is due to changes in lavaan (not semTools). The semTools
authors are working on this as we speak.

You can either downgrade lavaan back to 0.5-17, or specify the models
manually, and use lavTestLRT() to compare the two models.

Yves.
